annotations.title: Request financing from the sbaexpress.loans desk (Janover Capital LLC)

description: Send a financing request to the sbaexpress.loans desk (Janover Capital LLC) on behalf of a person who asked you to, through the same intake as https://www.sbaexpress.loans/get-financing/. Use it only when the person asked for it and agreed to be contacted. For an SBA Express, SBA 7(a) or other business loan for a U.S. small business. The request goes to HubSpot, marked as sent by an AI agent, and the desk reviews it before anyone calls. Partners may pay Janover Capital LLC a referral fee; the business pays nothing. It takes contact details and the loan request only: never send a Social Security number, date of birth, credit, bank or income information. Returns an acknowledgement that the request was received. It is not an application approval, a rate quote or a commitment to lend.

business_age.description: How long the business has operated (optional)

business_purpose.description: Must be true: the loan is for business or investment purposes, not personal, family or household use

contact_consent.description: Must be true, and only if the person named agreed to this statement: By submitting, you agree that we may share your information with our referral partners, including Commercial Finance Partners and NerdWallet Small Business, so they can contact you about your inquiry, and you consent to receive calls, texts, and emails (including via automated technology) from us and our partners at the contact details provided. Consent is not a condition of any service. Reply STOP to opt out of texts. Our partners pay us referral fees. You pay us nothing. See our Advertiser Disclosure, our Privacy Policy, and our Terms of Use.

details.description: Optional notes: annual revenue range, timing, what the money is for. No personal financial data and no credit score

email.description: Email address where the person can be reached

first_name.description: First name of the person requesting financing

loan_amount.description: Approximate loan amount in dollars; an estimate is fine

role.description: Business owner, or a broker acting for one (optional)

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state where the business is (optional)
